finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is genuine.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js`: it calculated tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount. Only the "order totals" cases with both a nonzero discount and a nonzero tax exposed this, which is why most of the wall of text was passing noise. Changed the tax calculation to use `discounted * taxRate` instead of `cents * taxRate`.
